build_mlp: build a multi-layer perceptron with configurable hidden dims, batchnorm, dropout, and optional sigmoid output
build_MultitaskCNN: build a multitask CNN for segmentation, depth estimation, and autoencoding from RGB images
build_QuestionLstmEncoder: build an LSTM encoder that embeds tokenized questions and extracts the last non-null hidden state
build_NavCnnRnnModel: build a navigation model combining CNN image features with an RNN for action prediction from questions
build_NavPlannerControllerModel: build a planner-controller navigation model with separate planning and control RNNs for embodied QA
